permissions.purpose: Identify the enrolled owner using Amazon profile:user_id; this scope does not supply vehicle consent.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Keep vehicle data and commands unavailable. Offer Amazon sign-in; never accept a client-supplied owner identity.

permissions.purpose: Record the owner's explicit consent to access and control the enrolled vehicle.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Do not submit vehicle requests. Explain consent on opening and provide the application Settings path to review it.

permissions.purpose: Collect the enrolled vehicle's OnStar location every 15 minutes and retain observations for the chosen period, at most 90 days.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Keep scheduled location collection paused. Preserve unrelated controls and allow consent review in application Settings.
